# Meridian 1.4.0
Arrange your world your way.
- **Horizontal** keeps the familiar side-by-side clock strip. - **Vertical** stacks full clock cards, with scrolling when the stack is taller than the screen. - **Independent clocks** splits selected regions into separate windows. Drag and snap each clock individually; each position is remembered. - Switch from the **layout icon** in any title bar, **More** in the menu bar panel, or **Settings**. - Closing an independent clock hides only that clock, keeping its region selected. **Open** in the menu bar restores all desktop clocks. - Preserve selected regions, language, menu bar clocks and the original horizontal position on upgrade. Existing seconds orbits, full dates, weather, locking and Always on top work in every layout. - Keep all seconds orbits aligned with a shared whole-second clock sample, including after switching layouts. - Improve source build compatibility with older Swift compilers.
Download **Meridian-1.4.0-macOS.dmg**, open it and drag Meridian.app onto Applications. ZIP is for signed Sparkle updates. Universal for Apple Silicon and Intel; macOS 14 or later.
This build uses ad-hoc Apple code signing and is **not Apple-notarized**. Sparkle update signatures are verified separately. **Noncommercial use only**, under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. Third-party notices are included.
## 简体中文
新增**横向排列、纵向排列、独立时钟**三种桌面布局。从标题栏布局图标、状态栏“更多”或“设置”切换。
独立模式下，每个地区都是单独的窗口，可分别拖动、吸附并记忆位置。关闭某一张只收起该时钟，不会删除地区；状态栏点击“打开”恢复全部。纵向排列过长时可滚动查看。
升级保留已有地区、语言、状态栏选择和横向面板位置。完整日期、环形秒数、天气、锁定和置顶在所有布局中可用。
请下载 **DMG 安装包**；ZIP 用于签名自动更新。此版尚未经过 Apple 公证，仅限非商业使用。
